_about: Interstate '76 live-tunable constants, derived from i76-map\subsystems\*.md (static reading of md5 9a232dcc, 2026-09-27). exe-scope defaults are checked against the pristine image by `python i76tune.py --offline list`. Values marked 'imm' are instruction immediates in .text (the operand bytes of one instruction); everything else is a .rdata/.data constant. Entity and component entries are per vehicle and have no fixed default.

scopes.exe: absolute VA in the game image (every car and AI)
scopes.entity: player's vehicle entity = [[[0x54a264]]+0x70], offset relative to it

entries.name: gear rpm factor, reverse
entries.meaning: R[0]: rpm = 850 + wheel_rpm x final_drive x R[g] (physics_UpdateEngine 0x46a550). Index 1 (idle) is unused.

entries.name: gear rpm factor, 1st
entries.meaning: R[2]. Higher = more rpm per km/h = shorter gear; the rev limiter (power < 0 above 7000 rpm) caps 1st at about 104 km/h stock.

entries.name: gear rpm factor, 2nd
entries.meaning: R[3]. Stock engine-limited top in 2nd about 182 km/h.

entries.name: gear rpm factor, 3rd
entries.meaning: R[4]. Lower = taller top gear (more speed per rpm, less drive per m/s). Stock engine-limited top 261 km/h; aero drag sets the real top speed.

entries.name: final drive ratio
entries.meaning: Multiplies wheel rpm x R[g] into engine rpm (0x46a55b). Scales every gear at once.

entries.name: wheel circumference
entries.meaning: Speedo mph = wheel_rpm x circumference / 60 x 2.2369 (0x46a56b). Its reciprocal at 0x4be2cc turns m/s into wheel revs for the rpm formula; both are rewritten together.

derived.note: 0x4be2cc = 1 / circumference (wheel revs per metre, read at 0x46a342)

entries.name: wheel revolutions per metre
entries.meaning: 1 / wheel circumference. wheel_rpm = |v| x this x 60 (0x46a342). Normally set through wheel_circumference.

entries.name: idle / neutral rpm
entries.meaning: rpm shown in P/N and at idle (0x46a548); also the free-rev easing floor (0x46a639).

entries.name: geared rpm offset (negated)
entries.meaning: Stored negated: rpm = wheel_rpm x final_drive x R[g] - (this) = ... + 850 (fsub at 0x46a561). -850 means 850 rpm at a standstill in gear.

entries.name: free-rev rpm span per unit throttle
entries.meaning: Skidding / airborne / P-N: rpm eases toward 1050 + 4950 x throttle (0x46a67d).

entries.name: free-rev base rpm (negated)
entries.meaning: Stored negated (fsub at 0x46a69e): free-rev target = throttle x span - (this).

entries.name: free-rev rpm cap
entries.meaning: Free-rev rpm is clamped here (0x46a6e9).

entries.name: peak power rpm
entries.meaning: Drive power = f x (P - k x (rpm - 3500)^2) (0x46a75f..0x46a77d), k = P/3500^2 fixed at load. Moving this shifts the parabola: peak here, zero power at this +- 3500 (the upper zero is the rev limiter).

entries.name: engine health factor floor, offline AI
entries.meaning: f = max(hp/max, floor) multiplies drive power (0x469fd9). A destroyed AI engine still gives 27.5%.

entries.name: engine health factor floor, player / network
entries.meaning: Same floor for the offline player and every network car (0x469fe1). Takes effect at the next engine damage event (the factor is stored at eng+0x18).

entries.name: speedo m/s to mph factor
entries.meaning: Last factor of the grounded speedo reading (0x46a577). Set 3.6 for a km/h speedo (needle art still says mph).

entries.name: 60 (s/min; also 2nd->1st kickdown km/h)
entries.meaning: DUAL USE: wheel_rpm = revs/s x 60 (0x46a356) AND the full-throttle kickdown speed 2nd -> 1st in km/h (0x46a258). Changing it alters rpm, the speedo and the shift point together.

entries.name: m/s to km/h
entries.meaning: Speed scale fed to every shift threshold (0x46a144, 0x46a3bd). Raising it makes the gearbox think the car is faster: all shift points move down together.

entries.name: closed-throttle threshold (upshift rule)
entries.meaning: Throttle below this uses the closed-throttle upshift speeds 25 / 40 km/h (0x46a3fd, 0x46a46d, 0x46a493).

entries.name: full-throttle threshold (upshift, 2nd kickdown)
entries.meaning: Throttle above this uses the full-throttle upshift speeds 62 / 106 and the 2nd -> 1st kickdown (0x46a4a4, 0x46a247, 0x46a27e).

entries.name: full-throttle threshold (3rd kickdown)
entries.meaning: Throttle above this arms the 3rd -> 2nd kickdown at 98 km/h (physics_AutoDownshift 0x46a195).

entries.name: throttle deadband idle <-> 1st
entries.meaning: Idle -> 1st as soon as throttle > this (0x46a51c); 1st -> idle below it under 0.5 km/h (0x46a2f5). Also gates the free-rev branch (0x46a5f9).

entries.name: upshift 1st -> 2nd, full throttle
entries.meaning: 0x46a4c6 / 0x46a504. Stock 1st reaches its rev limit at about 104 km/h, so there is headroom.

entries.name: kickdown 3rd -> 2nd, full throttle
entries.meaning: physics_AutoDownshift 0x46a1a6 / 0x46a1ee. The 2nd -> 1st kickdown (60) is wheel_rpm_x60.

entries.name: downshift 3rd -> 2nd, closed throttle
entries.meaning: 0x46a1dd / 0x46a22c, throttle below 0.25 (0x4be2a4).

entries.name: downshift 2nd -> 1st, closed throttle
entries.meaning: 0x46a28f / 0x46a2de, throttle below 0.3125 (0x4be2b8).

entries.name: closed-throttle threshold, 3rd downshift
entries.meaning: 0x46a1bb.

entries.name: 1st -> idle below
entries.meaning: With the throttle under the deadband the box drops to idle below this speed (0x46a306).

entries.name: single-player brake strength numerator
entries.meaning: physics_InitEntity (0x438f7e) calls physics_BrakeSetStrength with 2300/m offline, replacing the BRAK file value. Applies at vehicle creation: changes affect cars spawned afterwards. For the live player car set brake_strength (component scope).

entries.name: brake acceleration gain
entries.meaning: a = brake+0x10 x throttle x 8, capped by four-wheel traction (0x43c4a3). Every car.

entries.name: handbrake slide minimum speed
entries.meaning: Handbrake forces a slide only above this speed (0x43ac10).

entries.name: handbrake traction cap (dual: airborne clearance)
entries.meaning: DUAL USE: brake traction cap x0.5 on handbrake (0x43c4dd) AND the clearance in metres above which the car stays airborne (0x43a779).

entries.name: gravity, slope pull (y of vector)
entries.meaning: y of the (0, -9.8, 0) vector projected onto the ground normal for the slope pull and slide test (0x43aead..0x43aec2).

entries.name: gravity, airborne (imm)
entries.meaning: Immediate of `push -9.8` at 0x43a6a1, passed to phys_Integrate while flag 4 (airborne) is set. Instruction operand in .text.

entries.name: gravity for ground-normal load
entries.meaning: entity+0x46c = 9.8 x n.y^3, the wheel load that scales traction and rolling drag (0x43a0cf).

entries.name: aero drag scale
entries.meaning: a = -0.1 x drag(VDFC +0x38) x v^2 (0x43ada4). Sets every car's top speed; halve its magnitude for about 1.4x the terminal speed.

entries.name: nitrous drive multiplier
entries.meaning: Drive accel x5 while entity flag 0x800 (nitrous, 15 s) is set (0x43c58f).

entries.name: lateral accel per unit grip (dual: AI turn speed)
entries.meaning: Steering lateral limit = 7.84 x sum(wheel grip) when flag 0x10000 is clear (0x43cee0, 0x43c78a). 0.8 g. Past twice the limit the car slides. The AI's copy is ai_turn_speed_grip.

entries.name: steering pull from a blown front tyre
entries.meaning: Player only: +0.3 (0x4bd1e8) or -0.3 (0x4bd1e4) added to steer with a flat front tyre (0x43cf5b..0x43cf9b). Both signs are rewritten.

entries.name: airborne pitch-rate target
entries.meaning: In the air the pitch rate eases toward -pi/20: the nose drops (0x43a811). 0 keeps the attitude; positive lifts the nose.

entries.name: surface damage speed threshold
entries.meaning: Above this the WRLD surface damage rate applies each substep (0x43a168). Set 1000 for damage-free terrain.

entries.name: fall-kill height
entries.meaning: Airborne and more than 35 m below the last ground height -> object_Destroy (0x439ace). The f64 twin at 0x4bd190 (0x439e57) is rewritten with it.

entries.name: max physics substep (imm)
entries.meaning: Immediate of `push 0.05` at 0x46385c in entity_TickVehicle, the stepper's max step (rate 20). Smaller = more substeps per frame; the suspension IIR and contact model are tuned to 42-50 ms steps.

entries.name: blown tyre radius factor
entries.meaning: physics_WheelBlowTyre multiplies the tyre radius by this once (0x46dde1). The trainer's repair divides by 0.688, so keep them equal.

entries.name: suspension bump feed-forward (negated)
entries.meaning: Suspension target = offset + 5 x (d - d_prev) (0x46dcea). 0 removes the feed-forward (softer, laggier ride).

entries.name: slide yaw gain numerator
entries.meaning: physics_InitEntity sets entity+0xb4 = 2.65618 / wheelbase (0x438f5c): the angular-impulse gain. Applies to cars created afterwards; for the live car set yaw_gain (entity scope).

entries.name: walkable face minimum normal y
entries.meaning: Faces of class 11..13 structures with plane ny > 0.4 count as drivable ground (0x43e443).

entries.name: contact restitution factor
entries.meaning: e = clamp(1 - 0.75 (v.n/|v|)^2, 0.25, 1): head-on hits bounce least.

entries.name: minimum restitution
entries.meaning: Floor of e. Raise toward 1 for bouncy terrain hits.

entries.name: push-out speed along the normal
entries.meaning: A terrain hit slower than 4 m/s (|v'|^2 < 16 at 0x4bd15c, rewritten as the square) becomes a 4 m/s push-out.

entries.name: upward rebound damping
entries.meaning: An upward rebound (v'.y > 1) is multiplied by 0.2 (static-other branch).

entries.name: contact angular impulse gain
entries.meaning: Angular impulse = speed x 0.1 on a terrain / static hit. Higher = more spin from scrapes.

entries.name: impact damage K, vehicle vs rigid body
entries.meaning: physics_ApplyCollisionDamage: damage ~ K x mass x |impact|^2 when the other body is rigid.

entries.name: impact damage K, vehicle vs terrain / static
entries.meaning: Same with the car's own mass, for terrain and scenery hits (landings too). 0 = no crash or landing damage.

entries.name: FFB jolt per damage point
entries.meaning: Force-feedback jolt = amount x 0.02 for hits over 20 damage.

entries.name: offline player component hp multiplier
entries.meaning: entity_InitVehicle multiplies engine, suspension, type-20, brake, wheel and special hp by 4 for the offline player (0x463702..0x463768). Applies at vehicle init (mission start / respawn), not to the live car. The armour and chassis x2 is an `fadd st0,st0` instruction (0x463673), not a constant.

entries.name: critical-hit health threshold
entries.meaning: Handgun hits (record+6 bit 0) target component 6 (the critical 0x4020 kill) when health% < 33 (0x463db4, 0x465ba5). With the stock health-fraction bug this is true as soon as a core component is scratched.

entries.name: kill-roll factor, offline player (imm)
entries.meaning: Immediate of `mov [esp+0x2c], 0.1` at 0x465caf. A hit on a destroyed component kills when total x k > rand()%100 x cur/max. 0.1 = hard to kill; 2.5 = as fragile as AI.

entries.name: kill-roll factor, AI / network (imm)
entries.meaning: Immediate at 0x465cbb. Smaller = tougher AI once their components are gone.

entries.name: Cup Holders absorb chance (imm)
entries.meaning: Immediate of `cmp edx, 10` at 0x465b7e: a type-9 special absorbs a whole component hit when rand()%100 < this.

entries.name: damage visual level 0/1 ratio (dual)
entries.meaning: DUAL USE: side/wheel ratio > 0.75 -> level 0 (texture frame 0); damage smoke starts below 0.75 health fraction (0x466ca4); tyre-cover hit multiplier x0.75 (0x466feb).

entries.name: damage visual level 1/2 ratio (dual: headlights)
entries.meaning: DUAL USE: ratio > 0.5 -> level 1 (texture only, mesh unchanged); headlights go dark below this min armour/chassis ratio (0x467539).

entries.name: damage visual level 2/3 ratio
entries.meaning: ratio > 0.25 -> level 2, else 3. A wheel at level 3 blows its tyre.

entries.name: damage smoke level 1 threshold
entries.meaning: Health fraction below 0.75 and above 0.6: smoke level 0 (rate 0); below 0.6: level 1, rate 0.5 (0x466cbe).

entries.name: damage smoke level 2 threshold
entries.meaning: Below 0.4: level 2, rate 1.0 (0x466cd7).

entries.name: health fraction span (components intact)
entries.meaning: object_HealthFraction = 28 + 72 x min side ratio when engine, suspension and brakes are all >= 0.9999 (0x40b6be). Offset is health_frac_offset.

entries.name: health fraction offset (negated)
entries.meaning: Stored negated (fsub at 0x40b6c4): 72 x r - (-28).

entries.name: core component 'intact' ratio
entries.meaning: Any core component below this switches object_HealthFraction to the unscaled 0..1 branch (the stock smoke / flee / hpLesser bug, 0x40b5da). Set 0 to make every car use the percent branch (a blunt version of I76_FIX_HEALTH_PCT: component damage then never lowers the readout).

entries.name: core component 'dead' ratio
entries.meaning: With all three core components below this, object_HealthFraction returns 100 (0x40b58d).

entries.name: radar jammer duration (negated)
entries.meaning: Active while now <= start + 8 s (fsub -8.0 at 0x46171d). -30 = 30 s per use.

entries.name: Heated Seats ammo multiplier
entries.meaning: Every mounted weapon's ammo x1.1 at spawn (0x4a4b14). Applies to cars spawned afterwards.

entries.name: Mud Flaps chassis multiplier bonus (negated)
entries.meaning: Chassis absorb multiplier += 0.1 while fitted (stored as -0.1, 0x4656ef..0x465759).

entries.name: nitrous duration (imm)
entries.meaning: Immediate of `push 15.0` at 0x43d2a6 (physics_FireNitro -> entity_StartTimedState(0x800, 15)). Shares the timer with oil-slick traction loss (2 s) and the wreck (10 s).

entries.name: player projectile damage factor, easy
entries.meaning: weapon_BuildImpactDamage: the offline player's shots x this when difficulty 0x654b9c = 0 (0x4a770c). AI shots use 1.0.

entries.name: player projectile damage factor, medium (dual: handgun)
entries.meaning: Difficulty 1 (0x4a7704); the .45 handgun (ordnance 0x12) always uses this one (0x4a76df); also the network default (0x4a7883).

entries.name: player projectile damage factor, hard
entries.meaning: Difficulty 2 (0x4a76fc).

entries.name: player flamer damage factor, easy
entries.meaning: weapon_UpdateFlamerStreams (0x4443cd): flame damage = max(1, int(GDFC damage x f x dt)) per segment per render call.

entries.name: player flamer damage factor, medium (dual: 1.0)
entries.meaning: Difficulty 1 (0x4443c5); also used as the literal 1.0 in the flame bend maths (0x444132, 0x444682), so keep it near 1.

entries.name: player flamer damage factor, hard
entries.meaning: Difficulty 2 (0x4443bd).

entries.name: projectile gravity
entries.meaning: weapon_BuildProjectileStepState (0x4a746e): multiplied by the ORDF gravity factor (0 guns, 0.1 handgun, 4 mortars). 0 = flat shells and bullets.

entries.name: weapon jam probability offset (network only)
entries.meaning: Network games only: p = min(1 - condition - 0.3, 0.5) per frame for a firing weapon under 70% (0x4a4345). Offline weapons never jam.

entries.name: rocket speed easing rate
entries.meaning: weapon_StepRocket: speed eases toward the ORDF speed at 0.5 x dt (0x4aa5ea). Larger = reaches cruise speed sooner.

entries.name: shooter immunity distance
entries.meaning: Rockets, heat and radar missiles cannot hit their shooter for the first 70 m flown (0x4aa7cf, 0x4abb97, 0x4aaf9d, 0x4ab6fb).

entries.name: radar missile: turn only below this dot
entries.meaning: weapon_StepRadarMissile turns only when dot(nose, to-target) < 0.998 (about 3.6 deg off) (0x4aab62). 1.0 = always correcting; 0.9 = lazy.

entries.name: radar missile turn gain
entries.meaning: Turn = 0.75 x cross(nose, to-target), then clamped by the per-band limits (0x4aabf1).

entries.name: radar missile near band end
entries.meaning: Distance flown below which the near turn clamp (sin 3 deg) applies (0x4aabba).

entries.name: radar missile far band start
entries.meaning: Beyond this the far clamp (sin 20 deg) applies; between the bands sin 15 deg (0x4aac21).

entries.name: radar missile turn clamp, < 15 m
entries.meaning: sin 3 deg per step (0x4aabf9). Also read by the jammer-proof variant 0x4ab1c0.

entries.name: radar missile turn clamp, 15-150 m
entries.meaning: sin 15 deg per step (0x4aac2e).

entries.name: radar missile turn clamp, > 150 m
entries.meaning: sin 20 deg per step (0x4aac53). Lower all three clamps to make missiles dumber.

entries.name: radar missile terrain floor (negated)
entries.meaning: Missile y is held at terrain - (this) = terrain + 0.5 m (fsub at 0x4aaf66, 0x4ab6c4).

entries.name: cluster bomblet spread span
entries.meaning: weapon_ScheduleClusterBomblets: offset = rand x 20 - 10 per axis (0x4a9115, 0x4a9146). Keep cluster_spread_half at half of this for a centred pattern.

entries.name: cluster bomblet spread half-width
entries.meaning: Subtracted after the span multiply (0x4a911b, 0x4a9153). Normally set through cluster_spread_span.

entries.name: cluster bomblet fuse spread
entries.meaning: Bomblet delays are spread over 1.8 s (0x4a918f).

entries.name: tumbling mine restitution, normal (negated)
entries.meaning: weapon_StepTumblingMine bounce: normal velocity x -0.5 (0x4a9b24). Landmines, Car-E-Racer, BloxDropper.

entries.name: tumbling mine restitution, tangential
entries.meaning: Tangential velocity x -0.25 on each bounce (0x4a9b0a, 0x4a9b19, 0x4a9b91).

entries.name: AI fire gate scale, guns (class 1/2)
entries.meaning: ai_ShouldFireWeapon: three rand()%1000 summed must be < 6000 x combat skill (0x41853f). The sum is at most 2997, so at skill 0.5 (3000) the gate always passes; 0 = AI guns never fire; 1500 = passes about 1 roll in 2 at skill 1.

entries.name: AI fire gate scale, mortars (class 3)
entries.meaning: Two rand()%1000 summed < 3500 x skill (0x418e3c). Max sum 1998, so it passes always above skill 0.57.

entries.name: AI fire gate scale, rockets / missiles (class 4)
entries.meaning: rand()%5000 (0x41825d) < 1000 x skill^2 (0x418272): p = 0.2 x skill^2 per frame (per 20 Hz window with the proxy's hold). 0 = AI never fires rockets; 5000 = every roll.

entries.name: AI throttle cap base
entries.meaning: ai_UpdateThrottle caps at 0.75 - (-0.25 x drive skill) (0x40fcb8, 0x4101d3). 1.0 with slope 0 = every AI car at full throttle.

entries.name: AI throttle cap skill slope (negated)
entries.meaning: Stored negated (fmul then fsubr base at 0x40fcb2).

entries.name: AI turn-speed grip constant
entries.meaning: ai_ComputeTurnSpeed: sqrt(7.84 x sum of four wheel grips / steer gain) (0x40f94f); also in ai_SteerToHeading (0x40ffec). The AI's belief about cornering grip - keep equal to lateral_grip_limit or the AI over/under-drives corners.

entries.name: flee-when-hurt ground distance gate
entries.meaning: ai_ShouldFleeWhenHurt first compares object_GetGroundDistance(car, target) with 80 (0x41707a); only then tests HealthFraction < 30 + 17 x aggression (immediates). Static reading: the flee check is skipped beyond 80 m.

entries.name: dirt_standoff hold distance
entries.meaning: Behaviour 9 keeps >= 70 m and faces the target (0x41c6dd).

entries.name: projectile-dodge gate base
entries.meaning: ai_TestControlCandidate checks incoming projectiles when rand()%1000 >= 850 + 150 x (1 - steer skill) (0x41b669): p = 0.15 x skill per call. 0 = always check (AI dodges everything, 3x as often at 60 fps).

entries.name: projectile-dodge gate skill slope (negated)
entries.meaning: Stored negated (0x41b663).

entries.name: AI forward sweep box length per sim_dt
entries.meaning: ai_FrameTick: box = 50 / sim_dt m (1000 m at 20 fps, 3000 m at 60) (0x40a4f7). Broad phase only.

entries.name: evade weave threat range (squared)
entries.meaning: Evade (0x4210b4) and race (0x420c24) weave 5 m off the route line when the threat is within sqrt(8100) = 90 m.

entries.name: weave period base (negated)
entries.meaning: Weave flag toggles every 2 + rand()%4 s (fsub -2 at 0x421027).

entries.name: goto: steer above which the car slows to turn speed
entries.meaning: Follow-path update 0x420f3c: |steer| <= 0.45 keeps the FSM speed, above it the turn speed.

entries.name: evade: steer limit for full speed
entries.meaning: 0x42113e (0.6 while weaving, ai_weave_steer_limit).

entries.name: evade/race weaving: steer limit for full speed
route end arrival radius (squared)
entries.meaning: ai_AdvanceWaypoint: the last route point is reached within 10 m (0x4150a7).

entries.name: path node reached radius (squared)
entries.meaning: Within 40 m of the current path node the index advances and a replan is requested (0x415130).

entries.name: route start cell leave radius (squared)
entries.meaning: Route index 0 -> 1 within 26.9 m of the start cell (0x415181).

entries.name: waypoint passed when DirCos > this
entries.meaning: Route point k is passed when the cosine at route[k] between the next leg and the car is > -0.1 (0x4151cb); the race start node search uses the same rule (0x4209cc).

entries.name: approach-target brake distance
entries.meaning: ai_ApproachTarget: a stopped, aligned target under 60 m brakes fully; beyond it speed = (D - 60) x 0.2 (0x42046e, 0x420490, 0x42062d).

entries.name: follow: at-slot radius
entries.meaning: isAtFollow is true within 2.5 m of the formation slot (0x41f094).

entries.name: follow: brake distance, leader stopped
entries.meaning: 0x41f14b; also the overshoot aim factor x4 (0x41f3c3).

entries.name: follow: full-drive distance
entries.meaning: Leader moving and more than 150 m away: speed 1000 (0x41f1f1).

entries.name: follow: mid-range distance
entries.meaning: 50 < dist <= 150: speed = vL + 0.7 x (dist - 2); below: vL + 0.4 x (dist - 1) (0x41f21a).

entries.name: follow: hard-turn distance for turn speed
entries.meaning: Steering hard with the leader moving: dist >= 100 m or vL <= 5 m/s gives the turn speed (0x41f2d7).

entries.name: follow: closing speed reduction
entries.meaning: Closing on the slot: speed = vL - 5 (0x41f501); also the vL <= 5 m/s turn-speed test (0x41f2e8).

entries.name: follow: overshoot speed factor
entries.meaning: After overshooting the slot the car drops to 0.75 x the leader's speed (0x41f4b8).

entries.name: track_distance clamp minimum (dual: 1.0)
entries.meaning: Orbit / chase: track_distance (0x53678c) clamped to [1, 10] x target radius (0x407b15, 0x4062e8, 0x405cd1). DUAL USE as the literal 1.0 in the overview zoom (0x408a45).

entries.name: track_distance clamp maximum
entries.meaning: 0x407b32, 0x406305, 0x405cee. Raise to let the F2/F3 cameras pull further back (still capped by cam_distance_cap).

entries.name: orbit angle step per input unit per call (negated)
entries.meaning: F2 / end-of-match orbit: pitch/yaw -= input x 1 deg per frame (0x4061e7, 0x406233, 0x405bd0, 0x405c1c). Frame-rate dependent: a 60 fps game wants about -0.0058.

entries.name: orbit pitch minimum (dual: deg->rad)
entries.meaning: Orbit pitch floor 1 deg (0x4061f9). DUAL USE: the hood camera's head-look degrees-to-radians factor (0x4076b5, 0x4076d8, 0x40770a).

entries.name: orbit pitch maximum
entries.meaning: 0x406216: 90 deg (straight down).

entries.name: cockpit / hood head-look ease rate
entries.meaning: x += 4 x dt x (target - x) (0x4076bd, 0x4059bf). Snaps when 4 x dt > 0.95.

entries.name: enemy / target view height (negated)
entries.meaning: F4 / F5: camera 3 m above the anchor (fsub -3 at 0x408de4).

entries.name: enemy / target view distance back
entries.meaning: 7.5 m back along the anchor -> other line (0x408e38..0x408ebc).

entries.name: enemy / target view maximum down-tilt
entries.meaning: Tilts down with distance, capped at 30 deg (0x408ec6).

entries.name: missile camera pitch
entries.meaning: F11: 20 deg down in the projectile frame (0x409585).

entries.name: far-vehicle physics radius base
entries.meaning: camera_Init: cam+0x18 = 600 x zoom x sqrt(1 + tan^2(fov/2)) (0x472499); beyond that + 25 m cars run the cheap kinematic model. Applied at the next camera_Init (view change / zoom), independent of the far clip.

entries.name: far clip source (mission)
entries.meaning: camera_ApplyViewOptions uses this when Visibility Range is on, else 150 (0x4059d5..0x4059e9). Written from the WRLD at mission load and re-read on a view-options apply (level start, video mode change). Past about 3.8 km the depth-bucket ceiling (0x48fe61) drops geometry anyway (docs/DRAW-DISTANCE.md).

entries.name: road segment view-z cull
entries.meaning: Road segments whose midpoint view z exceeds 450 m are not drawn (0x48ead7).

entries.name: positional sound cull distance (squared)
entries.meaning: Voices 600 m or more from the player car are refused or parked (0x421c35, 0x422bf1, 0x42281e, 0x422ce6).

entries.name: 3D voice minimum distance (imm)
entries.meaning: Immediate of `mov [0x5fce74], 10.0` at 0x421a2b (sound_Update3DPosition). DirectSound gain = min/d between min and max: raise for louder distant engines.

entries.name: 3D minimum distance, detached one-shots (imm)
entries.meaning: Immediate at 0x421a1c for flag 0x200 voices: vvcoll / vbcoll / vexplode and sound_PlayOneShotAt.

entries.name: 3D voice maximum distance (imm)
entries.meaning: Immediate of `mov [0x5fce78], 400.0` at 0x421a35.

entries.name: engine loop pitch: idle rpm
entries.meaning: f = 8268.75 + 8268.75 x (rpm - 1050) / 4950 Hz (0x424cde..0x424d04). Keep equal to idle_rpm for the idle loop at its sample rate x 0.75.

entries.name: engine loop pitch: 1 / rpm span
entries.meaning: 1/4950. Larger = pitch rises faster with rpm.

entries.name: engine loop pitch: base frequency
entries.meaning: 0.75 x 11025: the loop's playback rate at idle. Its negated twin 0x4bcd04 is rewritten too.

entries.name: tyre sound minimum speed
entries.meaning: physics_PlayTyreSounds: turn / dust / flat / brake-damage loops only above 7 m/s (0x43d559).

entries.name: melee respawn delay
entries.meaning: Spawn / regen points, also offline melee (0x451595, net_RegenPointTick).

entries.name: 'ST' send interval minimum
entries.meaning: Interval = mean latency / 3 clamped to [0.2, 0.5] s (0x453260, 0x45377d).

entries.name: 'ST' send interval maximum (dual: 0.5)
entries.meaning: 0x453796; DUAL USE as the 0.5 in latency = (now - echo) / 2 (0x453694).

entries.name: vehicle mass
entries.meaning: entity+0xa4, VDFC mass plus components. Drive a = P/(m v), brake 2300/m, vehicle-vehicle momentum, impact damage. 1/m at +0xa8 is rewritten with it (offline brake strength is NOT recomputed: set brake_strength too).

entries.name: aero drag coefficient
entries.meaning: entity+0x120 (VDFC +0x38): a = -0.1 x drag x v^2. Sets the top speed in 3rd.

entries.name: drive power multiplier (blower)
entries.meaning: entity+0x128: 1.0, or 1.25 with a Blower. Multiplies drive accel every substep (0x43c587).

entries.name: collision multiplier (VDFC +0x34)
entries.meaning: entity+0x124. No reader found in the exe (engine.md); included so it can be watched.

entries.name: wheelbase
entries.meaning: entity+0x118 from the WLOC positions. Steer gain +0x110 = 1/(2 wb) and slide yaw gain +0xb4 = 2.65618/wb are rewritten with it. Yaw rate = steer x v / (2 wb).

entries.name: steer gain 1/(2 wb)
entries.meaning: entity+0x110, read at 0x43cfdb. Set directly for a quicker or lazier steering response without moving the wheels.

entries.name: angular impulse gain 2.65618/wb
entries.meaning: entity+0xb4: w += k x dw on contacts (0x4396d2).

entries.name: yaw pivot (rear wheel z)
entries.meaning: entity+0x11c: the car yaws about this point along forward (0x43b8da). 0 = about the centre.

entries.name: transmission lever
entries.meaning: entity+0x104. 5 ('1') holds 1st, 4 ('2') holds 2nd.

entries.name: engine hp
entries.meaning: engine+0 (max at +4). Health factor f = max(hp/max, floor) is recomputed on the next damage event.

entries.name: engine hp max
entries.meaning: engine+4 (ENGN hp x4 for the offline player).

entries.name: engine power P
entries.meaning: engine+0x14 (ENGN +4). Drive = f x (P - k (rpm - 3500)^2) with k = P/3500^2 at engine+0xc, rewritten with it so the curve keeps its 0 / 7000 rpm zeros. Behaves like watts: a = P/(m v).

entries.name: engine power curve k
entries.meaning: engine+0xc = P/3500^2 at load. Set it alone to reshape the curve: smaller k = flatter curve, power stays high past 7000 rpm (higher rev limit).

entries.name: engine health factor f (live)
entries.meaning: engine+0x18, multiplied into the power every substep; rewritten by the engine damage handler (0x469fb0) on each hit. 2.0 = double power until the next hit.

entries.name: engine rpm (read-only in practice)
entries.meaning: engine+0x1c, rewritten every substep. For `watch`.

entries.name: brake hp
entries.meaning: brake+4 (max at +8).

entries.name: brake hp max
entries.meaning: brake+8.

entries.name: brake strength
entries.meaning: brake+0xc: 2300/m offline (BRAK strength in network games). The effective value brake+0x10 = max(hp/max, 0.2) x strength is rewritten with it; a = +0x10 x throttle x 8, traction-capped.

entries.name: suspension hp
entries.meaning: susp+0 (max at +4).

entries.name: suspension hp max
entries.meaning: susp+4.

entries.name: suspension handling (slide threshold)
entries.meaning: susp+0x14 (SUSP +4): the steering lateral limit gn x handling x grip x sum(wheel.c)/4 when flag 0x10000 is set; decays to 0.5 with damage.

entries.name: front-left wheel hp
entries.meaning: slot 0 wheel+4 (max +8). Grip decays to 0.5 and rolling drag doubles with damage; level 3 (<= 25%) blows the tyre.

entries.name: front-left tyre grip factor
entries.meaning: slot 0 wheel+0xc = hp/max x base (+0x10), floor 0.5; reset to that on every hit. Feeds the traction and slide sums.

entries.name: front-left base grip (WDFC size factor)
entries.meaning: slot 0 wheel+0x10. Survives hits (grip is recomputed from it).

entries.name: front-left tyre radius
entries.meaning: slot 0 wheel+0x1c (x0.688 when blown). Ground contact and ride height.

entries.name: rear-left wheel hp
entries.meaning: slot 4 wheel+4 (max +8). Rear wheels drive.

entries.name: rear-left tyre grip factor
entries.meaning: slot 4 wheel+0xc. Rear grip caps the drive acceleration (0x43c543).

entries.name: rear-left base grip (WDFC size factor)
entries.meaning: slot 4 wheel+0x10.

entries.name: rear-left tyre radius
entries.meaning: slot 4 wheel+0x1c.
